fpc.fold.summary: Fold a declared flex chain (rigid lines plus bend arcs) into 3D; neutral-axis length through each bend is radius*angle and is preserved, never scaled.

inputs.chain: Nonempty array of {type:line,length} and {type:bend,radius,angle,axis?} objects defining the flex chain.
inputs.outline: Optional flat polygon outline; arbitrary 2D outline folding is a documented gap.
inputs.bendZones: Optional array of declared bend-zone descriptors.

limitations: The whole outline is never treated as flexible; only declared bend zones bend. FPC folding is a recipe; native ECAD/flex is a separate gate. No scaling is applied to any length.

fpc.flatten.summary: Flatten a declared flex chain to its flat equivalent; neutral-axis length is preserved and bend arcs are straightened without scaling.

inputs.outline: Optional folded outline; full 2D outline flattening is a gap.

limitations: Flat length equals folded neutral-axis length; the FPC is not scaled. Only declared bend zones contribute arc length.

pcb.mechanical-exchange.summary: Neutral PCB exchange reporting the explicit datum offset between a STEP center and a lens/pad datum and the outline diff, without conflating them.

inputs.source: PCB descriptor with datum {name,type,origin}; type is mechanical, step-center, lens or pad.

limitations: A STEP bounding-box center is a source of position, not a lens/pad datum; the offset is explicit and must not be silently adopted. The exchange reports a diff, not an accepted vendor STEP.

pcb.check.summary: Validate PCB thickness, holes/slots, both-side height zones, courtyards and copper keepouts against a declared board outline.

inputs.board: Object with thickness (positive), outline (polygon), holes (round/slot), heightZones (top/bottom), courtyards, copperKeepouts.

limitations: Validates declared geometry, not native ECAD layer stackup. Height zones must be declared for both sides (top and bottom).

port.define.summary: Define a connector port frame with origin, normal, pin1 and optional key, mating stroke and support zones.

inputs.name: Port name.
inputs.frame: Object with origin ([x,y,z]), normal (unit direction), and optional pin1 ([x,y,z]).

limitations: Metadata/recipe port definition; not a native ECAD connector feature.

connector.mate-check.summary: Check intended and forbidden connector pairs including poka-yoke: a forbidden pair that can reach seating position (shared key/shroud signature and pin count) is reported.

inputs.intendedPairs: Nonempty array of [maleName, femaleName] intended mates.
inputs.forbiddenPairs: Array of [aName, bName] pairs that must not mate.
inputs.insertionOrientations: Optional object mapping pair keys to allowed insertion orientations.

limitations: Similar 4-pin power/data/encoder connectors are unsafe unless their key/shroud signatures differ; a physically possible wrong connection is detected, not assumed safe because each intended pair mates.

pack.cross-section.summary: Compute occupied-union area, free area and reserve (denominator = cavity area) with real outline shape fit, not just equal areas.

inputs.reserve: Required free-area ratio in [0,1], default 0.3; denominator is cavity area.
inputs.samplingBudget: Positive integer for union-area estimation, default 200000.

limitations: Free area alone does not prove routing; occupied-union area is a grid estimate. Shape fit requires every item to lie within the cavity; equal areas with mismatched shapes do not pass.

keepout.check.summary: Check copper keepouts and courtyards against a board outline and report keepout violations.
limitations: Declared-geometry check; native ECAD keepout layers are a separate gate.
